summary.text: John Donohue is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Joan Fitzgerald.
His campaign website describes him as an Army veteran who served for 27 years.

paragraphs.text: Donohue's campaign website describes him as a constitutional conservative.
It lists the values he holds as individual liberty, economic opportunity, limited government, rule of law, personal responsibility, and security at home and abroad.
